title: Amazon wants to help the Colorado River, but we still don’t know how much water the company uses
summary: The Colorado River faces an ‘unprecedented’ drought as data centers demand more water. Amazon’s annual sustainability report shares water use per unit of power (l/kwh) for its data centers since 2021, but not the company’s total water use over that time period.
